But in a way if you wanted to read a review rather than my rambling about the game now, here is something I wrote for a friend when I had played the game for about 15 hours

The game is not bad. It has a lot of things you can do and experiment with. Some of it does seem repetitive but the game still manages to surprise you. If you enjoy exploring and survival type games then this game definitely has all those elements.

You will end up mining minerals in this game for hours at an end (only because you hit the jackpot), other times you will be at the edge of your seat because you are stranded and you need a certain element to GTFO (has happened to me twice and I had to endure the elements of a crazy hot planet before I found the mineral I needed). The story is sub par at best. The graphics are okayish but could have been better. Customization is there but I think it needs a patch or two to fix some minor annoying grievances.

Environments can change drastically. One minute you are in a lush green world and then the next system brings you onto a planet that is devoid of all life but is a miners heaven. The same goes for wildlife. The colorful visuals are extremely enjoyable although they can be a little straining after a while. Gives of that 70's vibe IMO.

I definitely recommend the game for what it has to offer as of now although I would say that the current price point is too high for this game.
